extensions.name: Cosmic Clarity
extensions.summary: Cosmic Clarity denoise, dark-star, sharpening, and super-resolution workflows hosted through the extension runtime.
extensions.description: First-party AfterNight adapter for the Cosmic Clarity tool suite. It provides denoise, Dark Star, sharpening, and super-resolution processes while keeping the upstream Cosmic Clarity executables outside the package and user-configurable.
extensions.author: AfterNight / Seti Astro

assets.name: cosmic_clarity-1.0.0-all.tar.zst
assets.signature_detail: Unsigned official package; SHA-256 verified from index

releases.changelog: Initial official repository release of the Cosmic Clarity adapter.

extensions.name: GraXpert AI
extensions.summary: GraXpert background extraction, denoise, and deconvolution processes hosted through the extension runtime.
extensions.description: First-party AfterNight adapter for GraXpert AI background extraction, denoise, and deconvolution. The package keeps only AfterNight-specific adapter code; the shared GraXpert dependency context is provisioned from hash-locked official PyPI wheels during install.
extensions.author: AfterNight / GraXpert Development Team

assets.name: graxpert-1.0.1-all.tar.zst
assets.signature_detail: Unsigned official package; SHA-256 verified from index

releases.changelog: Switch GraXpert to a thin PyPI-backed package. Official PyPI wheels are hash-locked and downloaded by the host during install instead of being redistributed as release-asset payload.
